label_ja: モード別の調整（ofa）。サモナーズリフトの値と混同しない

data.Aphelios Binding Eclipse: * ''Binding Eclipse'' expunges all enemies affected by ''Gravitum'' from any '''Aphelios'''.
data.Draven Q: * Axes can be picked up (stolen) by allied '''Dravens'''. (The same can be done in any game where there are at least two '''Dravens'''.)
data.Ekko W: * ''Parallel Convergence'' will interact with all allied '''Ekkos'''.
data.Fiddlesticks Q: * The fear-immunity is shared across all '''Fiddlesticks'''.
data.Fiora R: * Attempting to cast ''Grand Challenge'' on a target that is already affected by it will inform the player that it "Cannot be stacked" once '''Fiora''' is in cast range.
data.Malphite E: * The {{tip|cripple}} can be applied more than once; it can be {{tip|stack|stacked}} by multiple ''Ground Slams''.
data.Quinn I:
* '''Quinns''' may only trigger the bonus damage from their own {{as|Vulnerable|gold}} debuffs. 
    ** Note that all active debuffs are visible to all '''Quinns''' and are not easily distinguished unless its appearance is modified by a skin.
    * Enemies can have multiple {{as|Vulnerable|gold}} debuffs active on them at a time.
data.Quinn W:
* '''Quinns''' will gain the passive bonus for attacking a {{color|#FFD300|Vulnerable}} enemy versus enemies marked by any '''Quinn'''. 
    ** Note that only the '''Quinn''' who applied the mark can consume the mark for bonus damage. One '''Quinn''' can apply the mark and then deliberately not trigger the mark to allow their allies to continually trigger the passive bonus.
data.Senna I:
* Wraiths are not shared.
    * ''Weakened Soul'' debuff application is individually tracked and does not interact among multiple users.
data.Syndra Q: * ''Spheres'' can be interacted with by allied '''Syndras'''.
data.Syndra R:
* Unleashed Power will grab ''all'' nearby ''spheres'', regardless of whose they are. <!--PFT: Only allies or also enemies?-->
    ** The damage is still capped at 7 ''spheres'', which appears to be the ''first'' 7 ''spheres''. Additional ''spheres'' will visually collide with the target but deal no damage.
data.Trundle R: * ''Subjugate'' {{tip|stacks}} if cast on the same target more than once by {{tt|other sources|other Trundles}}.
data.Zed R:
* Enemies can only have a single ''Death Mark'' on them at a time. Subsequent ''Death Marks'' will delete any previous marks, removing all accumulated damage and preventing the detonation.
    * Individual ''Death Marks'' will track the damage dealt by any '''Zed'''.
data.Zilean E: * The movement speed boost {{tip|stacks}} if ''Time Warp'' is cast on the same target more than once by {{tt|other sources|other Zileans}}.
data.Rod of Ages: * Timeless stack interval changed to 40 seconds.
data.Tear of the Goddess: * Each charge consumed generates 50% more mana.
data.Archangel's Staff: * Each charge consumed generates 50% more mana.
data.Manamune: * Each charge consumed generates 50% more mana.
